review_description: I had my system for 2 and a half years when the inverter failed. It has a 10 year warranty.I rang Graham and in 6 working days I had a new one installed.Great after sales service.
Of the three quotes I was to get only one contacted me. The contact made appointment with me for a few weeks ahead. Missed opportunity.

I contacted two other major installers along with GL Solar. The service from GL Solar was second to none, and the installation was completed within 2 weeks of my first contact. The others could not even give me an approximate installation date! I would 110% recommend Graham and his team.
